v23_provenance_observability.key_residual: 81/768 exact histories remain unresolved after complete occupancy plus provenance evidence

v24_colonization_age_memory.key_result: 45/81 v23 residual aliases hide different complete non-source first-arrival maps; 66/768 exact histories remain unresolved even with complete first-arrival state

scientific_question: Can hidden colonization-age differences create different present ecological states even when final occupancy and source provenance are identical?

latent_rows.reuse: the exact 384 v21-v24 directed landscapes, clustered/dispersed three-source sets and three frozen activation histories

frozen_age_dependent_process.name: two_step_maturation_delay
frozen_age_dependent_process.common_present_horizon: the v24 row/design T* = maximum finite non-source first-arrival time across all three activation histories
frozen_age_dependent_process.mature_state_rule: a non-source equilibrium node is mature at T* iff T* - first_arrival(node) >= 2
frozen_age_dependent_process.persistence: once reached, occupancy persists exactly as in v21-v24; maturation changes state label only

targets.mature_state_map: binary mature/not-yet-mature map over equilibrium non-source nodes at T*
targets.exact_activation_history: identity of the three frozen activation schedules

primary_subset: all design rows are scored, with preregistered focus on the 45 v24 hidden-age rows inside the v23 residual set
primary_outputs: mature-state equivalence-class count among activation histories
number of v24 hidden-age residual rows with different mature-state maps
number of v23 combined-observation aliases with different mature-state maps
number of exact-history-unresolved rows with a fully identified mature-state target
unique-origin and confluence nodes whose mature state changes across histories
mature-state disagreement fraction by clustered/dispersed source geometry
relationship between first-arrival disagreement and mature-state disagreement

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one of the 45 v24 hidden-age residual design rows has different complete mature-state maps among its observationally aliased histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if all 45 hidden-age aliases remain mature-state equivalent.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one v23 combined-history-unresolved design row has identical equilibrium occupancy and provenance but different mature-state maps.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if occupancy+provenance equivalence always implies mature-state equivalence.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For every design row, mature-state class count is <= first-arrival-map class count.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row has more than one exact activation history compatible with the complete first-arrival target hierarchy while all histories share one mature-state map.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if mature-state identity never compresses unresolved exact history.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one static unique-origin non-source node changes mature/not-yet-mature state across activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if unique-origin mature state is history-invariant everywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one static confluence non-source node changes mature/not-yet-mature state across activation histories.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if confluence mature state is history-invariant everywhere.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row has different first-arrival maps but identical mature-state maps under the frozen lag.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every age difference changes the mature-state target.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one design row has identical equilibrium occupancy across histories and positive mature-state disagreement.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if mature-state disagreement never persists after occupancy convergence.

secondary_outputs: fraction of the 45 hidden-age residual rows with mature-state consequences
fraction of all 768 design rows with mature-state history memory
maturity-target compression relative to first-arrival and exact-history targets
counts of age differences that are invisible under the lag-2 mature-state target
claim_boundary: The two-step maturation lag is a frozen synthetic process, not a calibrated demographic parameter.
Mature/not-yet-mature is an abstract present ecological state, not abundance, reproduction or fitness.
A mature-state difference demonstrates possible history dependence of present state under the declared process; it does not establish empirical priority effects.
No new extinction, density dependence, biotic feedback or evolution is introduced.
stop_rules: Do not change the maturation lag after scoring.
Do not add a second lag to rescue a failed hypothesis.
Do not add abundance or extinction after scoring.
Do not alter the common-present-horizon definition.
